## About

Inverse modelling over the **Germany–Netherlands–Belgium** border region: instead of a
handful of point sources, the state field is a grid of real emissions — lignite power
plants in the Rhineland, the ports of Rotterdam and Antwerp, steel along the Rhine and
Scheldt. A footprint forward model carries them by wind to real ICOS measurement towers
(optionally CO2M satellite pixels); the analytical inversion recovers a posterior emission
field from the synthetic measurements. The prior (the inventory) is the smoothed,
scalable estimate — the inversion doesn't get to see the "truth". Switchable by species
(CO₂/CH₄), sector and year.
